contamination_check.note: rows reproducing a measured utterance verbatim are dropped before training. This says nothing about vocabulary overlap, only that no measured utterance is itself in the training data.

provenance.template: authored by us (eval/training/parser_data.py): a floor on obvious breakage, not coverage
provenance.negative: public SQuAD 2.0 questions and small talk, labelled unknown
provenance.statement: third-party statements about the world, labelled unknown, built from vocabulary that does not appear in the civilization's speech (the held-out test for this distinction)
provenance.paraphrase: training half of eval/training/paraphrase.py (a local model rewrote a template; labels carried over only when every value survived verbatim). The evaluation half comes from disjoint template draws and is never trained on.

never_trained_on: tests/test_assistant_language.py (152 cases, written before this parser existed)
